name: RCON-Utils
author: Monster Spawned Studios | https://monsterspawned.studio
short: Game server management and utilties using the RCON protocol
description: A cog to manage game servers using the RCON protocol and provide utilities for game servers.
end_user_data_statement: This cog only stores data related to the game server, such as the server's IP address, port, and password, on demand (as it is needed for the cog to function).
install_msg: Thank you for installing the RCON-Utils cog! Please note that this cog is still in development and may not work as expected. If you encounter any issues, please report them to the developers at https://monsterspawned.studio/contact/.
